test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Anyone reading these lines __will thought that the writer is__ very sad.

options.text: will have think that the writer is
are think that the writer has
have thinking that the writer is
will think that the writer is

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Will think that the writer is.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **"will think that the writer is."**
 
• The original sentence is in the present continuous tense ("reading"), so we need a future tense to indicate a future event.
 
• **"Will think" **is the correct **future tense** to use here, as it indicates that the action (thinking) will occur in the future.
 
• The other options either use the wrong tense or incorrect verb forms.
 
• **Option 1** uses** "will have think,"** which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2** uses** "are think,**" which is also incorrect.
 
• **Option 3** uses **"have thinking," **which is the present perfect tense and is not appropriate for this sentence.
 
• Therefore, **option 4** is the most appropriate and grammatically correct option.

**Correct Sentence:**__* Anyone reading these lines __**will think that the writer is**__ very sad.*
